card.name: "One" or "more" after "more than"
card.fires_on: The word "more" in "one or more" and the word "one" in "more than one", where the quantity is about to be followed by a countable item such as injection, transfusion or amino acids.

modes.label: one or more
modes.description: "more" completes the phrase "one or more" before a list of conditions or substances.
modes.example: LILETTA is contraindicated when one or<< more>> of the following conditions exist

modes.label: more than one
modes.description: "one" ends the phrase "more than one" before a countable item such as an injection or tablet.
modes.example: If the dose requires more than<< one>> injection: Inject in different locations at least

card.plain: It marks the end of the phrases "one or more" and "more than one" when the text is about how many of something.
